properties.html:
The question has a situation/question followed by arguments labelled I, Il and III. Evaluate each argument on its own merit and choose the option that shows the correct combination of forceful arguments.
The decision of the government to waive off farm loans is a bad practice.
 Arguments:
I. Yes. Farm loan waivers shave off a certain percent off the gross domestic product and have a deflationary impact on the economy.
II. Yes. The problem of bad loans in the agricultural sector gets exacerbated when farm loans are waived off.
III. No. Even corporate loans are waived off from time to time.
IV. No. Farmers need to be encouraged to continue to grow food crops.

properties.html:
The Environment Ministry’s proposal to prescribe energy-efficient temperature limits for air-conditioning units in public facilities is a promising start. A lot of energy is wasted because of poor infrastructure and lack of understanding of efficiency metrics. According to a survey, adopting energy-efficient air conditioning units brought down electricity usage from 70% to 8% in public buildings and limiting temperatures was responsible for 66% to 90% savings on electricity. So the government should audit public buildings and adopt cleaner technologies in order to make them energy-efficient and eco-friendly.
Which of the following arguments is used in the above passage?
Emotive- referring to the wastage of energy
Analogy- comparing the wastage as being harmful to ecology
Statistical analysis - noting the amount of energy savings possible
Attack- pointing out the indifference of the government towards energy efficiency
